exposure: Distance of household from the hospital
Length of stay at the hospital
cohort: 390 women who gave birth at one referral hospital and two general hospitals in the Bale zone of Ethiopia
finding: The median hidden cost of institutional delivery was 877.5 ETB (32.03 USD), and was significantly associated with distance from the hospital, length of stay, mode of delivery, and family monthly income.
mod_finding: The median direct medical cost of normal delivery was 280 ETB (10.21 USD) while the direct nonmedical cost was 230 ETB (8.40 USD); for cesarean section, the median direct medical cost was 292 ETB (10.66 USD) while indirect costs were 591 ETB (21.60 USD); and for forceps delivery, the direct medical cost was 362 ETB (13.21 USD) while the direct medical cost was 360 (13.14 USD).
